Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2412
Options: A standard, B priority, C regional.
Observed successes:
- C accepted: small claim, east; large invoice, north.
Observed failures:
- C rejected: small claim north; small shipment east/north; large shipment east/north; large refund south/east.
- B rejected: large claim south; large refund east.
- A untested.
Patterns:
- Do not route shipments or refunds to C; all C attempts there failed.
- Claims: C works for small east, failed for small north. B failed for large south.
- Invoices: C works for large north.
Caveat: outcome text sometimes names a different option than the action taken (e.g., action B but says “C not valid”; action C but says “B not valid”). Trust the action/result pairing more than the rejection wording.
Next decision guidance:
- If request matches known success (small claim east; large invoice north), choose C.
- Otherwise, avoid C for shipment/refund; test A or B.
- B failed for large claim south and large refund east, so prefer A for those unless new evidence.
- Collect outcomes for A, and for B/C on remaining type-region-size combinations.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2422

Known accepted:
- C: small claim east; large invoice north; large claim east.
- A: large shipment south; small refund east; large claim south.

Known rejected:
- C: small claim north; small/large shipment east/north; large refund south/east.
- B: large claim south; large refund east.
- A: large claim east; large invoice east; small shipment east; small shipment south; small claim south; small claim north.

Patterns:
- C remains good for some claims/invoices: small claim east, large claim east, large invoice north. C still bad for shipments/refunds.
- A is mixed: works large shipment south, small refund east, large claim south; fails large claim east, large invoice east, small shipments east/south, small claims south/north.
- B has only known failures; no confirmed success.
- Outcome text may name a different option than action taken. Trust action/result pairing, not rejection wording.

Guidance:
- Choose C only for known C successes: small claim east; large claim east; large invoice north.
- Choose A only for known A successes: large shipment south; small refund east; large claim south.
- Avoid C for all shipments/refunds.
- Avoid B unless new evidence confirms success.
- For unmatched combos, do not repeat known failures. Test B first for small shipment east/south and small claim north/south; test A or B for large refunds/invoices not already covered.
- Continue collecting A/B/C outcomes for remaining type-region-size combinations.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2432

Confirmed successes:
- A: large shipment south; large shipment north; small refund east; large refund north.
- B: small shipment east; large claim north. (B small invoice east: accepted once, rejected once — unreliable.)
- C: small claim east; large claim east.

Confirmed failures:
- C: small claim north; shipments east/north; refunds south/east; large claim north; large invoice north. Note: C large invoice north was accepted earlier but rejected in REQ-2430 — now unreliable.
- B: large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east (mixed; also failed REQ-2423).
- A: large claim east; large invoice east; small shipments east/south; small claims south/north; large claim south. Note: A large claim south was accepted earlier but rejected in REQ-2426 — now unreliable.

Patterns:
- C only reliable for claims: small/east, large/east. Avoid C for shipments, refunds, large invoice north, large claim north.
- A works for large shipments (south/north), small refund east, large refund north. Do not rely on A for large claim south now.
- B works for small shipment east and large claim north. Small invoice east is mixed.
- Outcome text may name a different option than the action taken. Trust action/result pairing.

Guidance:
- Choose C only for small claim east or large claim east.
- Choose A for large shipment south/north, small refund east, large refund north.
- Choose B for small shipment east, large claim north.
- Avoid known failures and newly contradicted combos: A large claim south, C large invoice north, B small invoice east.
- For unmatched combos, test least-covered options, but collect A/B/C outcomes for remaining type-region-size combinations.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2442

Successes:
- A: large shipment south/north; small refund east; large refund north.
- B: small shipment east; large claim north; small invoice north (new, REQ-2434).
- C: small claim east; large claim east.

Failures:
- A: large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipments east/south; small claims south/north; small refund north (new, REQ-2436); large shipment east (new, REQ-2441).
- B: large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east (mixed/unreliable: failed REQ-2423 and later).
- C: small claim north; shipments east/north; refunds south/east; large claim north; large invoice north (unreliable: once accepted, rejected REQ-2430); outcome text also flags C invalid for small claim south and large invoice south (REQ-2433/2435).
- D entries in REQ-2433–2442: D is not a listed desk. Large invoice east D accepted once (REQ-2437) then rejected (REQ-2442). Treat D as noise; do not rely.

Patterns:
- C reliable only for claims east (small/large). Avoid C for shipments, refunds, invoices, large claim north, small claim south, large invoice south.
- A reliable for large shipments south/north, small refund east, large refund north. Avoid A for small refund north and large shipment east.
- B reliable for small shipment east, large claim north, small invoice north. B small invoice east is mixed.

Guidance:
- Choose C only for small claim east or large claim east.
- Choose A for large shipment south/north, small refund east, large refund north.
- Choose B for small shipment east, large claim north, small invoice north.
- Avoid: A small refund north; A large shipment east; C small claim south; C large invoice south; B small invoice east.
- For unmatched combos, test least-covered A/B/C; record type-region-size outcomes. Outcome text may name a different option than action taken; trust action/result pairing, except D/no-answer noise.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2452

Accepted / reliable:
- A: large shipment south; small refund east; large refund north.
- B: small shipment south; large claim north; small invoice north; large invoice east/south.
- C: small claim east; large claim east.

Rejected / avoid:
- A: large shipment north (REQ-2444), large shipment east; large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipments east/south; small claims south/north; small refund north; large refund east (REQ-2451).
- B: large claim south; large refund east; small invoice east (mixed/unreliable); small shipment east (REQ-2446); small invoice south (REQ-2448); small claim south (REQ-2452).
- C: small claim north/south; shipments east/north; refunds south/east; large claim north/south (REQ-2445); large invoice north/south.
- D: not a listed desk. Treat D/no-answer text as noise; ignore.

Corrections from new evidence:
- A large shipment north no longer reliable — rejected REQ-2444.
- B small shipment east no longer reliable — rejected REQ-2446.
- B small shipment south accepted REQ-2443.
- B large invoice east/south accepted REQ-2447/2449.
- C large claim east confirmed accepted REQ-2450.

Guidance:
- Choose C only for small claim east or large claim east.
- Choose A for large shipment south, small refund east, large refund north.
- Choose B for small shipment south, large claim north, small invoice north, large invoice east/south.
- For unmatched combos, test least-covered A/B/C; record type-region-size outcome.
- Outcome text may name a different option than action taken; trust action/result pairing, except D/no-answer noise.

Working notes — routing REQ-2403–2459

Accepted:
- A: large shipment south; small refund east; large refund north.
- B: small shipment south; large claim north; small invoice north; large invoice east/south (REQ-2457 confirms east).
- C: small claim east; large claim east; large claim south (REQ-2459).

Rejected / avoid:
- A: large shipment north/east; large claim east/south; large invoice east; small shipments east/south; small claims south/north; small refund north; large refund east.
- B: large claim south/east (REQ-2459/2455); large refund east; small refund east (REQ-2456); small invoice east/south; small shipment east; small claim south.
- C: small claim north/south; shipments east/north; refunds south/east; large claim north (REQ-2453); large invoice north/south; large shipment north (REQ-2458). Large claim south is now accepted, not rejected.
- D: not a listed desk. Treat D/no-answer text as noise; ignore.

Corrections from new evidence:
- Large claim south routes to C; A/B/D invalid (REQ-2459).
- B invalid for large claim east; C remains accepted.
- B invalid for small refund east; A remains accepted.
- B accepted for large invoice east (REQ-2457).
- C invalid for large shipment north (REQ-2458).

Guidance:
- Choose C only for small claim east, large claim east, large claim south.
- Choose A for large shipment south, small refund east, large refund north.
- Choose B for small shipment south, large claim north, small invoice north, large invoice east/south.
- For unmatched combos, test least-covered A/B/C; record type-region-size outcome.
- Outcome text may name a different option than action taken; trust action/result pairing, except D/no-answer noise.
